name: com.aifindme/directory
title: AI Find Me directory
description: Search a free directory of businesses and web shops and read their fact cards.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the AI Find Me business directory by words (a service, product, business name or feature), category and/or city. A sentence works too: small words ("where", "buy", "the") and shop words are ignored, plurals and accents don't matter, a country named last becomes a filter, a web address finds its listing. Listings with every word come first; when none has them all, the answer says relaxed: true and has listings with some. Returns up to 25 matching businesses with slug, name, category, city, a short summary, phone, website, whether someone proved control of the website or a mailbox (ownerVerified), when it was last checked, and the address of the full fact card; web shops also carry their platform, product count and categories. Use get_business with the slug for every fact, get_products for a shop's products.

query.description: Words to look for: a service, product, business name or feature

city.description: City name, as people write it ("Amsterdam"); see list_cities

country.description: Two-letter country code: NL (Netherlands), BE (Belgium), GB (United Kingdom) or US (United States)

shops_only.description: Only web shops (online stores), e.g. for "where can I buy X" questions

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get every fact the directory holds about one business: summary, about, category, address and map link, phone, email, opening hours (with the time zone when known), price range, cuisine, services, prices, FAQs, features such as wheelchair access or delivery, payment methods, languages, registration numbers, booking/order/menu links, social profiles. Markdown by default; json gives the structured card with the source of each fact and completeness.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: For a web shop: the shop facts (platform, categories, price range, currency, number of products, shipping countries, delivery time, free-shipping threshold, return period, review profiles, trust marks) and a sample of its products with name, price, stock, link and image, as the shop publishes them. Prices and stock are from the listing’s last check (the date is included). For a listing that is not a shop, shop is null and products is empty.

tools.name: list_new_listings
tools.description: Businesses newly listed in the directory since a date (default: the last 7 days, at most 90 days back), newest first, with their listing date; kind "shop" keeps the web shops, country (NL, BE, GB or US) one country. Poll it to learn about new shops and businesses; get_business and get_products give the facts.

since.description: ISO date or date-time, e.g. 2026-11-08 (default: 7 days ago)

country.description: Two-letter country code: NL (Netherlands), BE (Belgium), GB (United Kingdom) or US (United States)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the directory categories with their keys (for the category argument of search_businesses) and how many businesses each has.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have listings, most listings first, with the value to pass as the city argument of search_businesses. Optionally only cities with listings in one category.

category.description: Only cities with listings in this category
